To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the development of the technology of computerisation has a decisive role in the history of world modelling and (ii) the future of world modelling is related to the development of the methodological concepts of the new generation of models.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: what are the main methodological aspects of world models and how do they change?
the following questions: How did the world modelling evolve and how did it become the most important method of global analysis?
the methodological aspects and the future of the world models that can be run on personal computers, and with the role of the computer technology in the process of world modelling.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the future of world modelling is promising.
world models are not only a tool for forecasting, but also a methodological tool for the analysis of the world system.
world modelling has been a very successful field in the history of social sciences, and it will remain so in the future.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the development of computerised world models is not a simple technological process, but it is a complex process in which the development of computer science, the social and natural sciences, and the political sphere are intertwined.
world models have become more complex and more realistic, but the complexity of models is not a sufficient condition for their success in practice.
we have reached a stage in the development of world modelling where the methodological problems can be solved by the development of computer science.
The main takeaway from our work is that
world models are not only tools to describe the past and predict the future, but also to understand the complexity of the world and to develop a better understanding of the future.
the future of world modelling will not be a simple extension of the present, but a new, more complex, and more dynamic world model.
world modelling is an evolving and maturing science, and its future is bright.
